intentEvidence: A simple Obsidian plugin that enables hands-free reading using foot pedals.
motivation: I initially wrote this to integrate with my Coda STOMP (hence the name).
problem: Users who need hands-free operation, such as those using accessibility devices or reading long documents, lack a simple way to control scrolling and navigation in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: I initially wrote this to integrate with my Coda STOMP (hence the name)

summary: STOMP enables hands-free reading in Obsidian by integrating system key events from foot pedals to control scrolling and navigation.
